idle-1.note: 11:08, 1-minute load 1.9 at start (the minikube VM, Virtualization.framework, held 35-45 % of one core throughout; CPU here is per pid, so the VM does not count). +32 % CPU vs M12 (0.063) but 0.083 % against a 0.5 % budget; footprint 91 MB vs 96 MB.

busy-10.note: 11:21, load 1.9 at start. 0.993 % CPU against the 1.0 % budget, +42 % vs M4a's 0.70 %. Time Profiler (120 s, 1.34 s CPU, 86 % main thread): SwiftUI graph updates and layout of the two cluster overviews about 600 ms, ResourceStore.publish (re-sorting the Pod and warning-Event stores) 215 ms, sidebar badges 89 ms, dashboard derivation 53 ms. The test cluster changed under the scenario: a fixture CronJob (namespace batch, every 5 minutes) has accumulated 749 Pending pods (the node's 110-pod cap), so the all-namespace Pod list is 872 pods and FailedScheduling events update about 1.5 times a second; every busy-10 overview re-derives and re-lays out once a second as designed.

hidden.note: 14:23, load 2.9 (the VM and the owner's Safari). FAILS cpuAvgPct (0.21 % vs 0.1 %; M4b 0.092 %). Time Profiler (300 s, 725 ms): 685 ms are three Crow's Nest full evaluations right after the window closed, about 225 ms each, almost all JSON decoding of the 872 pods (5.3 MB) and 753 jobs; 286 ms of it was JSONValue.init(from:) building coding paths for thrown type mismatches (Pod.spec.volumes[].projected). Addressed in P2 (see P2.json).

hidden-min.note: 14:34. FAILS cpuAvgPct (0.15 % vs 0.1 %; M4b 0.097 %), same cause as hidden.

testLaunch.note: perf-launch.swift, 7 runs, idle-1 without -WHPerfKeepVisible, 14:45. Within budget; firstContentP90Sec 0.778 s vs P1 0.679 s (+15 %) and M4a 0.791 s: the run-to-run spread of the explicit-kubeconfig read (runs 0.47-0.78 s).

build: Profile build of main 453830b (M13 Rigging merged and gated off in Distribution, M14a widgets, the pane architecture, the multi-namespace filter and the accessibility pass), measured by the P2 pass before any P2 change.
note: The M13 baseline was never recorded on its own branch (earlier attempts ran on a busy machine or with the display off). These numbers were measured by P2 on main 453830b, which also holds M14a and everything merged after M13, so this file stands for both M13 and M14a (M14a is not in budgets.json's milestone list). No soak on this build: the P2 soak ran on the fixed build (P2.json). Previous baseline: M12 (idle-1 only).

environment.machine: Mac16,8 (Apple silicon, not the MacBook Air M1 reference Mac), on power, sampler holding caffeinate
environment.cluster: minikube wheelhouse-test, wh-perf fixtures, DRIFTED: a fixture CronJob (batch/report, every 5 minutes) had accumulated 749 Pending pods behind the 110-pod node cap, so the cluster held 872 pods and 753 jobs (M4b: about 550 and 430) and FailedScheduling events updated about 1.5 times a second. The coordinator cleaned it after these runs (118 pods, no churn), so later baselines measure a smaller cluster: compare busy-10 and hidden with that in mind.
